verdict.rationale: Convex documents its own scheduler "for running background workflows" and lists Crons as a built-in feature, so it covers both one-off scheduled background work and recurring schedules that run server-side without user involvement. The evidence is only brief marketing and pricing mentions. Missing for 10: dedicated scheduler/cron documentation detail (setup syntax, retry/durability semantics), evidence of the workflow component's behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
